name: Default
description: The stock character. Every core trait at the engine's own default weight, carrying the one stock quirk: it already reaches for damage. This is what every fight was fought with before personalities existed — edit it to move ALL enemies, or author a sibling to move one.

name: Aggressive
description: Fights forward. Cares far more about the damage it can project than about what it loses doing so, and taps units freely — its persistence dial is low, so a fragile unit is still worth fielding and swinging. STARTING POINT — never playtested.

name: Defensive
description: Plays to keep what it has. Its persistence dial is high — a unit likely to die this turn is worth almost nothing to it, so it screens, heals and retreats to keep worth alive. Holds formation, hoards its taps, and drops the damage quirk entirely. STARTING POINT — never playtested.

name: Board-oriented
description: Wants the richest battlefield: fields everything, buffs what stands, and treats an unspent hand as the real defeat. Reads as relentless rather than reckless — total value still speaks at the stock rate. STARTING POINT — never playtested.
